subtitle: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about GeoAnalyzer

general.q: How does GeoAnalyzer differ from competitors?
general.a: We are unique in our field. Competitors show 'where', while we answer 'how is it to live there?'. We don't just display objects; we aggregate them into safety, comfort, and investment attractiveness ratings, saving you dozens of hours of independent research.

general.q: What coverage does the service have?
general.a: Currently, we operate in Poland. We constantly add new locations. If you didn’t find your city, it means it’s queued for loading. Our goal is to cover as many locations as possible so everyone can find exactly what they need.

general.q: Can I use the service on mobile?
general.a: Yes, our interface is fully responsive. You can explore districts both from your laptop at home and on your smartphone on the go.

subscription.a: It’s perfect for those actively searching for housing. You get full Premium functionality for a symbolic fee for 7 days, usually enough to choose an apartment.
Yes, of course. You can disable auto-renew at any time in your profile settings. Access to paid features will remain until the end of the already paid period.

subscription.q: What are White Label reports in Realtor Pro?
subscription.a: This feature allows real estate agents to generate PDF district reports without the GeoAnalyzer logo. You can add your own contact info and branding, providing professional analytics to clients in your name.

data.a: We cross-verify data from multiple authoritative sources. However, cities are dynamic, and changes happen daily. We update the database as quickly as possible.

data.q: Where does safety information come from?
data.a: The safety index is based on official crime statistics, street lighting, presence of surveillance cameras, and proximity to police stations.

data.q: How often is the database updated?
data.a: Property prices and environmental metrics are updated in near real-time. Infrastructure changes are updated according to the primary registry schedule.

account.q: How can I contact technical support?
account.a: For prompt assistance, use the contact form on the website under 'Contacts' or write to us at youworkday@gmail.com. We respond within 24 hours.
We do not store your card data. All payments are processed by the international provider Stripe, which is PCI DSS certified at the highest level.
